title: BigP3BCI Study M — 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard (21 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of Study M from the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface resource. It contains 16-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 21 participants using a 9x8 character speller grid with adaptive and checkerboard stimulus paradigms. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags, supporting machine-learning work on P300 speller classification.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) at 256 Hz from 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage. Participants used a P300 speller with a 9x8 character grid and received online feedback. Data were collected in a laboratory setting using a calibration-then-test scheme, with target and non-target flashes as events.
